brief_rationale: The doctor successfully navigated a complex post-discharge scenario with family confusion about insulin dosing. All responsibility-chain items were met: medication reconciliation required multiple confirmations with ER/clinic doctors, hypoglycemia screening and plan were thoroughly communicated, glucose monitoring was established, follow-up was arranged, complication and red flag handling were addressed, and the afib anticoagulation issue was identified in records. Closure was safe with family teach-back. However, the afib anticoagulation issue (RC6) was identified through workspace records but never communicated to the family—this is a minor responsibility-chain error as the case contract requires advising family about the need for线下复评. This caps the grade at 2 (Borderline).
